hero.title: InterviewHub
hero.subtitle: LinkedIn Video Interview Rooms
hero.description: InterviewHub brings accepted applications' interviews together on one screen — video, chat and the candidate's profile side by side. Share the invite link and start meeting in two minutes.
hero.demoNotice: LinkedIn OAuth is not configured — demo mode is active

features.title: Everything an interview needs, on one screen

items.title: LinkedIn profile in the side panel
items.desc: Summary, experience, education and skills stay at a glance throughout the interview; opens on LinkedIn with one click.

items.title: End-to-end WebRTC video
items.desc: Audio and video flow encrypted browser to browser. The server only introduces the two sides and never touches the media.

items.title: Screen sharing
items.desc: Share your screen with one click for technical reviews and portfolio presentations.

items.title: In-meeting chat
items.desc: A persistent room chat for links, notes and documents; it stays even after the meeting ends.

items.title: Chrome extension
items.desc: While on LinkedIn, open a room with one click, send the invite link from the panel and keep the panel open.

items.title: Ownership and privacy
items.desc: Profiles are the participant's own declaration. You always decide what is shared.

steps.title: Live interviews in three steps
steps: Connect with LinkedIn — Login is verified with LinkedIn OAuth. Profile data is not pulled from the LinkedIn API; you enter the information yourself.
Open a room and share the link — Send the room's invite link to the candidate through a LinkedIn message. No extra setup, no extra account, no download.
Interview and read the profile — When the candidate joins, video and profile come together. Share your screen, chat, and decide on one screen.

footer.candidateProfile: The candidate's LinkedIn profile stays beside you during the interview
footer.webrtc: Audio and video never pass through our servers
footer.extension: Start meetings while on LinkedIn using the Chrome extension

items.q: Do you pull data from LinkedIn?
items.a: No. LinkedIn OAuth is used for login, but profile information is not taken from the LinkedIn API. Users enter the summary, experience, education and skills into their own profiles themselves; this content is a form submitted to us, not an automatic pull.

No. Audio and video flow directly between the two browsers over WebRTC; the server only carries the signaling (introduction) information. By default there is no recording feature and no media file is stored after the meeting.
A single set of commands: npm install, .env setup, npm run build and npm start. On average two minutes. Then you can open a room from the browser and share the invite link.
No. The entire flow works from the web app. The extension is a shortcut that makes it easier to open a room with one click while on LinkedIn and keep the interview panel open.

items.q: Can participants from different networks connect?
items.a: Yes. STUN is enough on most networks. For restricted networks like symmetric NAT, you can define your own TURN server in .env.
Both employers and candidates. Anyone who opens the invite link can join the room under their own name or with a LinkedIn login.
